title: Stock data assets: KWS weights/commands re-verified; fonts, images, EVENBAT checked; remaining placeholder is the fuel-gauge algorithm
scope: Host verification against official 2.2.6.10 blobs. No hardware. No flash. No commit. Codec GX8002 is not executed in Renode.

kws.note: The 2026-11-11/12 extraction is still in-tree and is what make source-bundle uses (--codec-a-weights-from-source). This step re-verified it and recorded format/offsets. It was not still a synthetic all-zero fixture.

weight_window.packaging: make source-bundle passes --codec-a-weights-from-source with provenance codec-a-kws-trained-weights-20261111.json

format.identity: LVP_KWS gxNPU model: command stream immediately followed by trained weights; no third section (0xF804+9164+120800=0x2F3B0 starts BINH B)
format.size_getters: command length movi r0,9164 at flash 0x8BF4; weight length movi r0,55264 + bseti r0,16 = 120800 at flash 0x8BFC
format.endianness: little-endian uint32 words in the C translation
format.header_word0: 0xa79bab66 (not zlib CRC-32 of the remainder; internal tensor grammar still unproven)
format.command_stream: 212 GXNPU commands, field-level C already emits the exact 9164 stock bytes

sim.host_verification: extracted bin, C words, and stock FWPK spans are byte-identical; stock BINH A NPU tail is cmd+weights

evenbat_battery_model.format: nrf_fuel_gauge 1.0.1 struct battery_model, 5632 bytes, name EVENBAT at +0x15C0

rom_fonts_uint8_arrays.format: LVGL 9 fmt_txt (LV_FONT_FMT_TXT_LARGE=1, 16-byte glyph dsc, plain-aligned bitmaps bpp 4)

app_image_assets.format: LVGL 9 L8 lv_image_dsc_t (28 bytes, header 0x619) + pixel arrays
app_image_assets.note: All six uint8 pixel arrays match official OTA once comments are stripped (a '20x20' size note must not be parsed as 0x20).

remaining_placeholders.status: The EVENBAT calibration tables are stock. The provider itself is still a source-only uncalibrated voltage/coulomb estimate, not the proprietary Nordic nrf_fuel_gauge algorithm (stock reports c205a2 / 2025-04-28).
Weight bytes are stock, but layer/tensor grammar inside the 120,800-byte bank is not independently proven.

sim_notes: GX8002/NPU is not in the G2 Apollo Renode model, so wake-word cannot be sim-executed here. Boot-time display frames were already byte-identical stock vs openCFW in the 22 Nov CHIPREV=0x22 paired Renode run (hash 0c5cc90b…). Current openCFW image contains the verified EVENBAT, font bitmaps, and image pixels (layout addresses differ).
